title: spec/ai: BlueprintObjectSchema has no sharingModel slot — the propose-stage LLM cannot author an OWD choice
body:
## Context

cloud#1466: the ADR-0090 OWD publish gate (`security-owd-unset`) refuses any custom object without a `sharingModel`. Cloud's fix stamps a deterministic default in every authoring path (business object → `public_read_write`, master-detail child → `controlled_by_parent`), and cloud's `objectBody` already reads an EXPLICIT `sharingModel` off the blueprint object via cast (the same forward-compat pattern as `recordName`/`expression`).

## Gap

`packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts` `BlueprintObjectSchema` carries no `sharingModel` key, and the schema strips unknown keys — so the propose-stage LLM cannot express a deliberate OWD choice (e.g. `private` for an HR/绩效 object the user described as personal), and the strict structured-output mirror cannot either. The deterministic default then overrides user intent expressed at propose time.

## Ask

Add an optional `sharingModel` slot (enum `private | public_read | public_read_write | controlled_by_parent`, with a description modeled on `object.zod.ts:1946`) to `BlueprintObjectSchema` AND the OpenAI-strict mirror (nullable there). No cloud change needed on top — the cast-read in `objectBody` (cloud `packages/service-ai-studio/src/tools/blueprint-tools.ts`) picks it up the moment the spec carries it.

Blocked-by: nothing. Back-link: objectstack-ai/cloud#1466.
